name: hx_effectiveness_ntu
title: Heat exchangers: effectiveness-NTU relations (function library)
summary: Seventeen EES FUNCTIONs for the effectiveness-NTU (epsilon-NTU) method of a heat exchanger: the heat capacity rates Cmin and Cmax, their ratio Cr, the conversions NTU = UA/Cmin and UA = NTU*Cmin, and the effectiveness eps(NTU, Cr) and its inverse NTU(eps, Cr) for counterflow, parallel flow, crossflow (both fluids unmixed, exact integral formula and closed approximate formula; Cmin mixed; Cmax mixed) and boiler/condenser flow arrangements.
language_features: DUPLICATE loop (inside a FUNCTION body and in the main program)
simultaneous equations for the implicit inversion

authors: A. Triboix (exact and approximate crossflow formulas)
T. L. Bergman, A. S. Lavine, F. P. Incropera and D. P. DeWitt (Introduction to Heat Transfer, 6E)
R. K. Shah and D. P. Sekulic (Fundamentals of Heat Exchanger Design)
origin.notes: ht 1.2.0, commit 85e0ee6 (2025-12-07), file ht/hx.py, functions calc_Cmin, calc_Cmax, calc_Cr, NTU_from_UA, UA_from_NTU, effectiveness_from_NTU, NTU_from_effectiveness and crossflow_effectiveness_to_int, MIT license, Copyright (C) 2016 Caleb Bell. The scientific basis of each relation is the original paper or book cited in its function comment block. Translation published under the CoolSolve_Library MIT license (decision D3).

verification.reference: doctest values of ht 1.2.0 ht/hx.py (case A: NTU = 5, Cr = 0.7, m_h = 22 kg/s, C_ph = 2200 J/kg-K, m_c = 5.5 kg/s, C_pc = 4400 J/kg-K, UA = 4400 W/K, Cmin = 22 W/K) and additional values computed with the same ht functions (case B: the steam/oil crossflow rating of the ht docstring, U = 275 W/m^2-K, A = 10.82 m^2); 50 output values in total
verification.notes: compare_solution.py: 50 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001). The largest relative deviation, 8.3e-8, is on eps_crossflow_B and comes from the composite Simpson quadrature (80 intervals) of the exact crossflow integral, which CoolSolve cannot evaluate inside the function; 1.4e-8 on eps_crossflow_A. Over the other 48 values the largest deviation is 5.1e-10, on NTU_crossflow_approx_A (convergence tolerance of the implicit inversion); the other 47 agree to 3.1e-13, i.e. round-off.
